answer: At the wharf of the PoA network each new agent must submit a signed proof of work tied to a unique hardware fingerprint stored in a tamper‑proof ledger; the fingerprint is hashed together with a cedar‑derived salt that only the verifier knows. The verifier checks the hash against an oasis of previously recorded hashes, rejecting any identity whose hash collides with an existing entry, and simultaneously publishes a honeypot challenge answer that only a genuine node can compute.
